notes.title: SHUFFLE TACTICS: PATCH 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Legends of Asteria![/p][p][/p][p]You asked, we listened. Here’s a new patch full of fixes based on your feedback : 
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]PERFORMANCES : [/b][/p][list][*][p]Performance optimizations for loading times.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]CARDS[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Corruption card (Professor) now has the Glimmer tag[/p][/*][*][p]The Targeted Strike (Catalina) can now target tiles without enemies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]CAMERA[/b][/p][list][*][p]The camera won't auto-move anymore when activating a card[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]RELICS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Glimmer Core relic no longer causes infinite softlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Sticky Oil relic no longer makes the oil tiles cost way too much MP. They also only cost more MP for the enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the Brawns over Brains Professor upgrade doing the opposite of what it said[/p][/*][*][p]Killing an enemy with a tile effect now properly credits the unit that did the kill, which should fix numerous relics and achievements that rely on who killed whom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Glimmer Stitching relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Local Spices relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Swamp Parasite relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Blast Shield relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Stunning Trap relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Blizzard relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Elemental Bracelet relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Elemental Resonance relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Empowering Transmission relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Fire Pendant relic[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the odds of Small Diamond relic triggering from 15% to 33%[/p][/*][*][p]Beast Claw can now only trigger 3 times per turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Known Weakness relic[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Training relic no longer triggers when cancelling a move[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Fire Shield upgrade for Emberwhiskers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed most of the Ranger's upgrades not having an associated buff[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]MISC FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a softlock that could happen when a Fletch defense was spawned (related to the Fletch Trap debuff)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous softlocks that would result from enemies that were just killed still being counted as living enemies for 1 second.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stuck tooltips on the screen when grabbing charms in the Charms Collector reward with a controller[/p][/*][*][p]The Tutorial panels can no longer appear outside of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]The Penetrate tag now properly works on Sword Throws[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Spectral tagged attacks to properly go through walls and units[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multi-target AOE cards not charging Mana Pylons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Excaliburn achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Hog Wild achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Blade and Switch achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Chain Reaction achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Control Group achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Hot Streak achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the King's Landing achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Last Stand achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Nailed to the Sword achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Mercy Kill achievement[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]LOCALIZATION/TEXT[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Toolbox tooltip no longer states that it costs 1 MP to activate.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Please don't hesitate to give us your feedback on our [url="https://discord.gg/vjDMQyGfzJ"]Official Discord[/url] or right here on Steam, and let us know if you encounter any technical difficulties![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186580/Shuffle_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Follow us on social media to keep up with the latest news:  [/p][p][u][b]X / Twitter:[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p] [url="https://x.com/ClubSandwichInc"]X - Club Sandwich[/url][/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://x.com/TheArcadeCrew"]X - The Arcade Crew [/url][/p][/*][/list][p]And join us on [url="https://www.facebook.com/gaming/TheArcadeCrew"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.threads.net/@thearcadecrew"]Threads[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/thearcadecrew/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/thearcadecrew.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@clubsandwichinc"]TikTok[/url]![/p]

notes.title: SHUFFLE TACTICS: PATCH 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[p]Greeting, Legends of Asteria![/p][p][/p][p]We're back with another patch to fix the following issues:[/p][p][/p][p][b]BALANCING[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrupted rifts: they now spawn enemies every 3 turns (vs 2 before). They can no longer have more than 4 active enemies at any given time (meaning that if 2 spawned enemies are alive, this rift won’t spawn more than 2 more).[/p][/*][*][p]Spawned enemies do not act until their next turn (this affects corrupted rift, reinforcement enemies, ghouls, and enemies summoned by bosses).[/p][/*][*][p]The Immobilized debuff no longer prevents you from playing movement cards, only from moving using Move Points.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wanderer boss[/b]: less HP, less movement, no more Last Stand buff, less overall damage, no more thorns buff, weaker armor buff, and drastically reduced parrying damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Augury Glimmerfolk boss[/b]: Less HP, less damage, weaker armor buff[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boxbird boss[/b]: Less HP, no more dense buff, no more permanent stun resistance, less damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Broodmother boss[/b]: Less HP, less movement, less damage, improved buff[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infant King boss[/b]: Less egg HP, less overall HP, less hatch armor, less damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Riders bosses[/b]: Less HP, fewer movement points, less damage, fewer spider web spawns, weaker overall[/p][/*][*][p][b]King Ogma boss[/b]: Less HP in all phases, less resistance, less damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deluge, Snarl, and Capital enemies[/b]: reduced move points across the board to make them less mobile, reduced damage across the board as well[/p][/*][*][p]Added more base HP to Fletch (25 -> 40) and Catalina (20 -> 35)[/p][/*][*][p]Fletch’s Toolbox is now free to use (instead of costing 1 MP)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the base HP of all sidekicks across the board to make them survive more, especially at lower levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]The cancel last move button has been moved to be more visible[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tooltip for the Catch card keyword[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the attraction effect on Inventory charms to make them easier to target[/p][/*][*][p]The “press F2 to provide feedback” text no longer wraps and overlaps the objective[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/p][list][*][p]A delay has been added after opening a relics booster and a charms booster, to prevent misclicks.[/p][/*][*][p]The Wild Heal card can now target self[/p][/*][*][p]Removed colliders from the spider webs in the Infant King’s arena to avoid them blocking projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Many improvements to the camera movement and the tactical camera switch and movement, to make them feel smoother and reduce the occurrences of jarring movement[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improved the enemies’ intent previsualisation. The range shown on the ground should now properly reflect the enemy’s movement range (including possible jumps), as well as their attack range. Direct ranged attacks properly account for covers in the preview, and for bosses, the range will also account for their current attacks and movements cooldowns. Note: This treatment has not been applied to the last three bosses yet and will be done very soon.[/p][/*][*][p]Distinguished the movement range from the attack range when previewing an enemy’s range.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]The tactical camera no longer triggers when pressing the left direction on the left joystick. Clicking the left joystick will trigger it.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer double-click a charm in the charm reward screen to grab it twice[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering a relic in the relic reward screen no longer shows its description as a duplicated tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Added Heavy buff to Fletch’s barricades[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical bug that would make saves become corrupted and make players lose their progress when exiting the game from inside a combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the graceful recovery mechanism when a combat action causes an error, which fixes a case where failing to spawn a Tribal Tomb would softlock the fight[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer switch units during the enemy’s turn by pressing shift and tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Fading keyword which was not working[/p][/*][*][p]Hide the “cancel last move” button while using a card[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the roof of the Infant King’s arena that would block the tactical camera view[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents from switching to tactical view during enemies’ turn and reset camera when the enemy’s turn begins[/p][/*][*][p]Re-enabled middle mouse button to move the camera[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the Overgrown Limb relic that would trigger all the time[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the Fletch’s Trap debuff which should increase Fletch’s damage against his defenses[/p][/*][*][p]Glimmering Glyph now properly gives one power per buff, as stated in its tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the carpet in the King Ogma’s Throne room that would clip ground markers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the missing translation of 2 extra options in the settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the Pain debuff translation in French[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please don't hesitate to give us your feedback on our notes.title: SHUFFLE TACTICS [DEMO] Hotfix 0.16.15

Hello everyone!

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue that prevented players from playing cards or moving after killing an enemy with the Paralysis Poison relic equipped.
[*] Fixed the movement zone’s previewing the wrong number of squares.
[*] Moved the active card a little bit to the right to grant better visibility.
[*] Fixed the few turns’ disparity happening when killing the Infant King’s egg once it has hatched. 
[*] Fixed an inventory issue happening when receiving rewards from an NPC.
[/list]

notes.title: [SHUFFLE TACTICS] NEW HERO UPDATE | ALPHA PLAYTEST PATCH 0.11.7
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Legends of Asteria![/h3]

Today’s 0.11.7 update introduces a new playable hero, UI improvements, and various bug fixes:


[h2]NEW HERO: FLETCH[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164273/b1c4f50a0d8ef148831df49886b2900cba4ce2d3.png[/img]

A Former Commander of the Royal Army who has taken up arms against the corrupted king Ogma. Fletch comes with 3 starter decks that reflect his distinct playstyle: 

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164273/a270ef3bf0981fdcd10f8fed7be0bafd8b71b4cd.gif[/img]
[*] [u][b]Skilled Archer:[/b][/u] Fletch can damage enemies from afar with his ranged attacks, creating powerful combos with elemental effects (such as poison + fire = explosion) or with devastating devices (powder barrels you can push, and then target to explode, ricochet device that allows your projectiles to bounce on it, etc).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164273/2e59686c8e8fe1a48f3ae21510eff7343d9332ac.gif[/img]
[*] [u][b]Builder: [/b][/u]Fletch is also a master at building fortifications and defenses on the battlefield: barricades, automated turrets, exploding devices, toolboxes, trenches, etc. He can fortify a position and benefit from sticking around.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164273/3dced41fcf3a97aaae0898171fdd9d8d00bee79e.gif[/img]
[*] [u][b]Commander: [/b][/u]Fletch can give powerful orders to his sidekicks to bolster them by increasing their strength and defense, as well as giving them extra action and movement points.
[/list]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]


[list]
[*] Added controller support: most of the game is now playable with a controller, except for shops and encounters! We'll continue to make improvements in the following updates.
[*] Added music to standard shop screen
[*] Hero selection screen: the screen UI and UX have been improved
[*]Inventory/Campfire screen: A new layout was for this screen added
[*]Victory screen: A new layout was for this screen added
[*]Sidekick recruitment screen: A new layout for this screen was added
[*]Elites Rework: Elite battles are now systematically Corrupted Rifts, which are no longer encountered in normal battles.
[i]We heard you! Corrupted Rifts caused difficulty spikes and felt too hard for regular battles, so now they will act as elite battles with powerful rewards[/i]
[*] Map screen: the screen layout has been improved
[*] Maps Rework: We resized combat arenas to not exceed 15 squares in either direction. For the time being, we've only done this resizing in The Deluge. We've also made the water on the Tiny River map non-accessible, to see if that helps legibility on this map.
[i]We feel this will help battles feel less drawn out with multiple turns spent getting closer to the enemy while keeping strategic options related to positioning open to the player[/i]
[*] Effects UI: Buffs and debuffs are now highlighted by floating text above characters.
[*] Markings & Effect legibility: We reworked the legibility of ground markings and effects: from now on, when a tile effect (fire, poison, oil, etc.) or marking (blue movement, red attack, danger zone, etc.) is applied to a tile, its props (i.e. grass, rocks, etc.) become hidden. The aim is to make these effects and markings clear and free from visual pollution. We also changed the visual of the "danger zone" markings, replacing the 3D skull with a red flat cross. 
[*] AOE preview: At last! Hero & Sidekick AoE attacks are now previewed on the ground.
[*] Overhaul of direct ranged attacks: Preview lines now show if a projectile is interrupted by an obstacle or enemy more clearly. In addition, interrupted projectiles now inflict status,  AoE, and tile effects on obstacles and enemies standing in their trajectory, as opposed to before when they only inflicted their base damage.
[*] Card Keywords: For clarity’s sake, the following Keywords have been changed to better reflect the card’s effects:
[list]
[*] Backstab -> Isolated
[*] Carnage -> Reload
[*] Pristine -> Healthy
[*] Tribal Rot -> Ghoul Master
[*] General -> Architect
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many localization fixes
[*] Improved UI performance on certain screens
[*] Soft locks no longer occur after an enemy steps on a tile already occupied by a Rusher
[*] Players no longer lose all cards (except skill cards) after selecting “Retry”
[*] The Hire button is no longer almost out of the screen on ultra-wide monitors
[*] Fied a bug where the Assassin's cards would remain on the screen  preventing the player from selecting another character to play (this issue happened after upgrading the sidekick to max in the sidekick shop and when Assassin killed the Marauder)
[*] Fixed a soft lock that would occur after King Ogma summoned the enemies during Phase 2.
[*] Fixed a bug where King Ogma’s sprite would become invisible at the beginning of the fight
[*] Fixed King Ogma’s tile that was too small to represent how many tiles he actually takes up on the map
[*] The attack preview of the Gloom Feathers now follows its position as intended
[*] The Ritualist no longer gets stuck in movement animation on the Snarl Bridge battle
[*] Relics now have counters
[*] The Infected effect now works correctly
[*] The Eclipse Relic now works correctly
[*] The Benevolent Eye Relic now works correctly
[*] Removed localization keys in the following descriptions:
[*] Description of the Ritualist Egg enemy
[*] Description of the Vanguard Egg enemy
[*] Description of the Scout Egg enemy
[*] Description of the Hunter Egg enemy
[*] Description of the Rusher Egg enemy
[*] Description of the Spider Web
[*] The HP and MP of the Scout enemy have been readjusted to their intended values  (27 and 3)
[*] Damage from the Hunter's Arrow Volley attack is no longer doubled if there is more than one ally in the Danger Zone
[*] The Hunter's arrows no longer damage heroes when they are standing behind the Hunter, outside Danger Zone marks
[*] The counter for the Agility Charm relic now resets properly after each turn
[*] Bandit enemies no longer spawn within assets on stages in the Snarl region.
[*] Enemies no longer spawn behind the wall in the battle with the Corrupted Rift in the Corner
[*]and many many more!
[/list]


Once again, we thank all of you for coming with us on this Alpha Playtest! Please leave your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/vjDMQyGfzJ]official discord
[/url] or right here on the Steam Forums!

notes.title: [SHUFFLE TACTICS] ALPHA PLAYTEST PATCH 0.10.11
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings Legends of Asteria![/b][/h3]

Version 0.10.11 of the Shuffle Tactics Alpha Playtest is live! Please read below for a list of improvements this patch implements: 
---
[b]IMPORTANT UPDATE:[/b]
[u]When losing a run, please use the "CONTINUE" button rather than the "RETRY" button![/u]

With Patch 0.10.11 we have noticed a new issue that could make it appear like the player has no cards in his deck but his initial skill card if the "RETRY" button is selected instead of "CONTINUE" on losing a run. 
- As a precaution, we invite you all to only use the "CONTINUE" button at the end of an unsuccessful run. 
-[b] If you find yourself affected by this bug, you can also work around it by exiting your application and starting a new run.[/b]
---

[list]
[*]New hero selection screen!
[*]New map screen!
[*]Improvement of the ground grid to make it visible through environmental elements, and more visible in general (e.g., not being hidden by grass)
[*]Resolution / Aspect Ratio fix for artifacts 
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a blocker where the main character could remain stuck in the same position as the Glimmerflock Augury
[*]Fixed a freeze that sometimes occurred after defeating the first Boss
[*]Fixed a UI issue where the screen became grey after the Rusher enemy attacked
